changed_blob_identity_proof: All 16 changed blob UTF-8 texts were fetched through GitHub at their exact blob IDs, re-encoded without modifications, and verified by byte length, SHA256 and Git blob SHA-1. Each changed path/mode/blob is independently checked in an untruncated GitHub tree for its original commit.
import_contract: Verify this transport and uncompressed packet hashes before use.
Require the exact base commit and base tree to exist in the destination object repository; stop on missing objects, without network probes.
Decode every blob and verify byte length, SHA256 and Git blob identity before git hash-object -w --stdin. Retain all returned object identities.
For each ordered commit, require the single original parent. Create a separate temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE outside the working tree; do not use the repository's normal index.

git read-tree the original parent into that private index; apply only the listed path/mode/blob cache entries; git write-tree must exactly equal the original commit's expected tree before creating its commit object.

Decode raw_commit_base64 without altering bytes, timezone, author, committer, message or terminal newlines. Verify its byte count, SHA256 and Git commit-object SHA-1; write with git hash-object -t commit -w --stdin and require the returned SHA to equal the original published SHA.
Read each created commit with git cat-file commit and compare the complete bytes to raw_commit_base64; verify parent and tree chain through the tip.

Do not checkout, reset, stage in the normal index, update any ref, re-sign, reauthor, amend, replace the original commit with a tree-equivalent new identity, or modify desktop source. Record the import outcome separately.
original_commit_identity_proof: For each of the four metadata records, author/committer timezone and terminal-newline candidates were examined. Exactly one reconstructed body matched the original published Git commit SHA-1. All four use -0500 and no terminal message newline. Full verified original bodies are included as raw_commit_base64; preserve them exactly.
qualification: Canonical Git object transport only; no compilation, behavior, source gate or ordinary A/B/C qualification is implied.
transport: ASCII base64 of gzip(mtime=0, level=9) of UTF-8 JSON; no newline is appended to the base64 transport. Decode base64 strictly, then decompress gzip.
tree_execution_limit: No local or desktop read-tree/update-index/write-tree import was executed during this preparation. The native importer must reproduce each complete original tree from the existing parent using the private-index contract before writing its original commit. Missing base tree/blob objects must stop the import.
